name: slice
context_rationale: This skill is interactive — it presents ranked candidates to the user, waits for their pick, may ask a structured confirm gate for bug-fix candidates, and co-derives the slice definition with the user before writing any artifact.
summary: Defines the next thinnest valuable vertical cut by reading the ranked candidate backlog from the unified candidates.json. Presents a ranked recommendation to the user and waits for explicit pick or 'you pick' before proceeding. On agreement, computes worktree paths, creates a git worktree + branch, writes mission-brief.json and milestone.json to the external vault store, claims the picked candidate in candidates.json (status, claimed_by, started_at, pick_log), and auto-advances to /risk-spike (the in-loop spike gate).

reads.purpose: Prerequisite check — confirms triage has run.
BFRD-1 bug-class signal only; candidate selection now reads candidates.json (not the risk ledger).
Primary source for active and recently archived slices; slice numbering reference.
Curated cross-slice action-points register — pattern-recognition input for candidates.
Alternative totals source for max slice number when active _index.json is unclear.
Read specific past slice reflections when a candidate clearly relates to prior work.
Compare stated scope to shipped work to surface unbuilt MVP features.
BFRD-1 verification: grep for tests/bugs/* rows to confirm a failing repro test exists.
Source graph for code-review-graph queries and PSQ-1 blast-radius computation.
Primary candidate source — pick the next cut from the unified backlog (replaces backlog.md + slice-queue.md + risk-register-as-candidate).

outputs.purpose: Primary deliverable: 1-page mission brief defining intent, ACs, verification plan, must-not-defer, gates.
Rolling state file tracking slice stage, next action, progress checklist, phase artifact links.
Claim the picked candidate: status=spiking, progress=spike, claimed_by {git_user,git_email}, started_at; append to pick_log.

tools.name: stranded_slice_audit
tools.purpose: Classify every unmerged slice/* branch into a 4-class divergence model to detect stranded/orphaned prior work before defining a new slice.

tools.name: risk_register_audit
tools.purpose: Return scored, sorted open risk candidates instead of a raw grep for HIGH/active entries.

tools.name: _worktree_paths
tools.purpose: Compute canonical worktree path and branch name — single source of truth shared with /build-slice and branch_workflow_audit.

tools.name: candidates_top
tools.purpose: Rank the live candidates.json backlog (blocked-on-spike + unmet-deps flagged) for the Step 1 recommendation.

tools.name: claim_candidate
tools.purpose: SVW-1 atomic claim: set status=spiking / progress=spike / claimed_by / started_at / slice + history + pick_log.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read vault state files: triage.json, risk-register.json, slices/_index.json, action-points.json, concept.json, archived reflection.json files, candidates.json (the unified backlog; NOT diagnose output — slice is decoupled from /diagnose).

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run stranded_slice_audit, risk_register_audit, _worktree_paths, code-review-graph queries, git worktree add, and the PSQ-1 Python inline invocations.

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Present the structured-options confirm gate for the BFRD-1 bug-fix prelude (must be structured options, not free text).

harness_tools.name: Skill
harness_tools.purpose: Auto-invoke /repro (BFRD-1 conditional confirm-then-auto-invoke) and auto-advance to /design-slice on clean completion.

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Locate the latest active slice folder under <vault>/slices/.

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Grep <vault>/shippability.json for tests/bugs/* rows during BFRD-1 verification; grep risk-register.json as fallback when audit emits zero risks.

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
